description: This file defines interfaces and a template class for a synchronous communication channel within the WPEFramework core namespace. It includes interface definitions for outbound and inbound messages, a nested Frame class managing message state and data transfer, and a template class SynchronousChannelType that manages message exchange, queuing, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: IOutbound
classes.description: Interface for outbound messages with serialization and reload capabilities, including a callback mechanism for updates.

classes.name: IInbound
classes.description: Interface for inbound messages with deserialization and completion status.

classes.name: SynchronousChannelType
classes.description: Template class implementing a synchronous communication channel with message queuing, sending, receiving, and state management.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Nested class within SynchronousChannelType managing individual message state, data transfer, and expiration.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Method to send a message and wait for its completion or timeout.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Method to cancel a pending message.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Method to enqueue a message for sending with optional callback and response.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Returns the descriptor of the resource.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications, triggering reevaluation.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to deserialize incoming data.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Method to send data over the channel, managing message queue and state.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Method to process received data, updating message states accordingly.
